title: The Cab Lab job file (job.v2)
description: Design-intent state saved by The Cab Lab. Only the module layer is stored; boards/faces/features are regenerated. Runtime enforcement lives in renderer/jobContract.js (validateJobInput before migrate, validateJobV2 after migrate) — this document is the authority those functions mirror.

version.description: job.v1 files are accepted at load and migrated to this shape before validation.

kind.description: Must be resolvable by renderer/spaces.js (e.g. "box", "vehicle"); an unknown kind is rejected at load.

planes.description: Named reference planes used for alignment/annotation.

walls.description: Partition walls; solids that cabinets and boards stop against.

finish.description: Job-level colour/side rules (colour slots), not per-cabinet settings.

id.description: Stable cabinet id; referenced by workpiece ids and relationships downstream.

moduleId.description: Generator module id. Must be registered in renderer/modules.js at load time — an unknown or retired id is rejected before migration runs.

params.description: Generator parameters; keys are defined by the module's own contract, not by this schema.

attach.description: Optional body this cabinet's pose follows (bed box, bed side table).

overrides.description: Per-board nudges keyed by board role id.
